verified.instrument: None on MDT. The discount is only capturable by tendering MDT into the exchange offer once launched (or by owning MMED directly); MDT common is not the instrument.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: Medtronic plc / MiniMed Group Inc., a live parent-sub separation) and G2 (concrete, company-guided commitment: IPO done Mar-2026, split-off to complete by end CY2026). G3 FAILS - there is no specific currently-unpriced figure; the re-derived event value is under 1% of MDT's market cap.
verified.edge: L - the event is real, dated and un-fired, but essentially nothing is left on the table for MDT common. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: ~0% (separation announced May-2025 with MDT ~$85-88; MDT is $86.20 today, and -19% from its $106.33 52-wk high - so the stake is arguably not being paid for, but nothing has been harvested either). Remaining capture to favorable resolution: ~+0.3-0.5%, i.e. de-minimis. Not mostly-harvested; simply too small to matter.
verified.primary_source: Medtronic newsroom, "MiniMed announces pricing of initial public offering" (2026-03-05) plus Medtronic Q3 FY26 earnings call reaffirming split-off completion by end CY2026; live prices from FMP batch-quote 2026-08-03 (MDT $86.20 / $110.3B cap; MMED $18.97 / $5.33B cap).
verified.analysis: Numerator re-derived from the capital structure rather than inherited: MMED's full market cap is $5.33B at $18.97 (FMP, 2026-08-03); Medtronic's retained ~88.7-90% is therefore worth ~$4.7-4.8B, or ~4.3% of MDT's $110.3B market cap at $86.20. A split-off exchange offer creates value only by retiring MDT shares at the customary ~7-8% (IRS/market-convention ~10% cap) discount to MMED value - so the mechanical accretion to remaining MDT holders is roughly 4.3% x 8% = ~0.35% of market cap, and the per-share arbitrage for a tendering holder is crushed by proration when a $4.7B offer is spread across a $110B holder base. The IPO cash (~$644-784M, largely intercompany debt settlement) was already banked in March 2026. Per the FIP rule, the waterfall cannot support a catalyst-sized upside, so the score reflects the equity - and the MDT equity case is a mega-cap medtech growth/margin recovery story, not a dated event. Gap: I did not pull the split-off S-4/Form 10 to confirm the exact retained-share count or an announced exchange ratio (the offer has not been launched), but no plausible ratio changes a sub-1% denominator conclusion; the tradable expression of this separation, if any, is MMED itself.

verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: People Inc / Barry Diller, existing 26.1% holder, specific $48.30 cash price) and G3 (specific unpriced figure: the 8.5% residual spread to the stated bid). verified.edge: M-to-L. RESIDUAL CAPTURE: pre-catalyst base = $38.92 (the 30-day VWAP ending 2026-05-29 implied by the stated 24.1% premium; last clean close before the 5/27 leak was $38.45). Run-up to today's $44.52 = +14.4%, i.e. ~60% of the total $38.92-to-$48.30 move is already harvested. Remaining to the contractual cash price = +8.49%. The skew is the problem: 8.5% up vs roughly -13.5% back to the unaffected price on a break, so the RR is ~0.63x and requires >62% deal probability just to break even. Worse, the spread has widened monotonically for two months - MGM closed $50.69 ABOVE the bid on 2026-06-01 (market pricing a bump), then $47.81 (6/30), $46.88 (7/10), $44.57 (7/31). Two months of the market progressively marking down deal odds is information, not mispricing.
verified.primary_source: MGM Resorts press release / 8-K on special-committee formation (disclosed ~2026-07-12/14, WSJ; re-reported 2026-07-30/31 by SBC Americas and News3LV) plus the People Inc proposal letter of 2026-06-01 filed on EDGAR (EX-99.1). Price data: FMP quote MGM $44.52 and EOD series 2026-05-20 to 2026-07-31, pulled 2026-08-03.
verified.analysis: The event is real, idiosyncratic and genuinely unresolved - a named strategic counterparty with a 26.1% toehold, a specific cash price, and a live independent special committee - so it clears G1/G3 and is not a macro bet. But two things cut the flag down. First, the triage's dated trigger is misdated: the special committee was formed and disclosed around 2026-07-12/14, not 2026-07-31; the 7/29-7/31 items are a CEO reiteration on the Q2 call that the committee "continues to evaluate," which carried no new information and on which the stock actually fell from $45.83 to $44.57. There is no three-day-old hardening trigger. Second, on residual capture the initiating event already fired hard (+30% intraday on 2026-06-01, 27.7M shares) and ~60% of the move to the bid is harvested; the remaining 8.5% sits against a ~13.5% break downside with a non-binding proposal, undisclosed financing, multi-jurisdiction gaming-licence transfer risk, and no announced decision timeline. Macau/Osaka asset optionality is a reason the committee may reject $48.30 as inadequate, not a reason the arb pays. WATCH rather than ACTIVE: the re-entry trigger is a signed definitive agreement (spread should collapse toward 2-4%) or a raised bid above $48.30 - either converts this from a 0.63x-RR proposal into a real arb.

verified.primary_source: Mirum/Incyte press releases: pivotal Phase 2 PROGRESS results in FOP presented as an ENDO 2026 late-breaker with FDA Priority Review and PDUFA 2026-09-26 (businesswire/ir.mirumpharma.com, 2026-06-04 acceptance PR, data late June 2026); VISTAS PSC primary endpoint met (2026-05-04); Q1 2026 results and Incyte worldwide license 8-K (2026-05-06, SEC CIK 0001759425); $600M 0.00% convertible senior notes pricing (2026-05-12). Price history and quote via FMP EOD/quote, 2026-08-01 close $104.65.
verified.analysis: The event survives the gate on form: it is real, specific, hard-dated (2026-09-26), forward and unfired, and in no way a macro bet — and unusually for this screen there is a second dated leg behind it (volixibat PSC NDA submission in 2H26 off a summer pre-NDA meeting). It fails on asymmetry. The pivotal PROGRESS readout already printed on 2026-06-26 with 81%/99.9% HO reduction, which makes September approval the ~90%+ base case; you are underwriting a decision whose good outcome is already the consensus and whose bad outcome (CRL) unwinds the ENDO move plus a confidence de-rate, giving roughly +19% against -18% on a re-derived $125 fair value versus an $86 floor. The numerator check is what caps this: FOP's ~400 US patients, with royalties flowing back to Incyte on an in-licensed asset, cannot independently support the ~35% gap to the $140-150 post-data targets — that gap belongs to volixibat and the Livmarli base, neither of which resolves on 2026-09-26. Mitigating the triage note, the stock is NOT mostly-harvested in price terms (it holds only +13.8% over the $92 pre-data base after a -18.6% retrace from the July peak), so this is a legitimate WATCH into the PDUFA rather than a discard — but the dated event is the wrong thing to own, and the re-rate worth having would be a volixibat NDA acceptance in 2H26, which is not yet a date.

RESIDUAL CAPTURE: (a) run-up from the pre-catalyst base is NEGATIVE — MKC traded roughly $60-63 before 2026-03-31 (inferred from the $58.58 200dma against four months in the low $50s) and sits at $51.53, so ~-17%; nothing is harvested, but that is because the market judged the deal value-destructive to the acquirer side, not because it was ignored. The triage's implicit anchors ($58.6 200dma, $72.6 year high) are pre-deal, pre-leverage standalone-McCormick flavor multiples that a 4.0x-levered $20B-revenue packaged-food roll-up structurally cannot re-earn until the $600M synergies land in 2029-2030.
verified.primary_source: McCormick IR press release "McCormick to Combine with Unilever's Foods Business, Creating a Preeminent Global Flavor-Focused Company" (ir.mccormick.com, 2026-03-31) and Unilever plc press release same date; PRNewswire "McCormick Announces Operating Model, Executive Team, and Secondary Listing Location for Combined Company" (2026-07-23); synergy/leverage/dividend figures from Unilever plc Form 425 business-combination communications filed with the SEC (2026-03-31/04); price and moving averages from FMP quote, 2026-08-03 ($51.53, 50dma $49.57, 200dma $58.58, 52wk $44.82-$72.58, mkt cap $13.85B).
verified.analysis: The event is real and correctly identified, but the triage's core framing — "early-arc, unmoved" — is factually wrong: the combination was announced 2026-03-31, four months ago, and MKC has already re-rated about -17% on it (and -29% from the $72.58 year high). The catalyst has fired; what remains are process milestones (S-4/Form 10, shareholder votes, antitrust) on an already-priced deal, and the "suppressed acquirer" thesis reduces to a bet that the packaged-food multiple compression overshot — a sector-multiple mean-reversion call, not a discrete event. Per numerator provenance I re-derived the payoff from the capital structure rather than inheriting a target: MKC holders get no cash premium at all, only 35% of an entity carrying ~$18.8B of net debt (4.0x) against $4.7B EBITDA, which pencils to ~$61 at 12.5x synergized versus $51.53 today — real but thin, with a symmetric -15% at peer multiples. The one genuinely mechanical, still-unpriced element is the forced distribution of a NYSE-primary US foods company to FTSE/AEX-indexed Unilever holders, but that lands at close in mid-2027, the company has already named its mitigant (LSE secondary listing, NL HQ, 7/23) and the stock did not respond — so the correct posture is to date a re-look into the close window and be the buyer of that dislocation, not to pre-position eleven months early and pay the carry. Score capped at 4 on derived-not-contractual upside plus fired status.
